title: metadata-protocol: /published and ?member= answer 404 where the equivalent plain read answers 200, although resolveBundleMemberSelector treats them as one request
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: contract review item ③ on PR #34644 (card #34441, review 6940385771), a baseline on `main` the PR leaves as it is, passed on by area `o2-I`. Dedupe: `published member selector 404 resolveBundleMemberSelector`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server

## 维护者速读

- 现象:cell 1 形态下(打包类型)同一个元数据，两种按理等价的请求答法不一致：`/published` 答 404,普通读答 200 并给出 fr-FR 那一行;`?member=en-US` 答 404,不点成员答 200。可 `resolveBundleMemberSelector` 把这两组请求都当作同一个请求。
- 为什么要修：同一个请求换种写法结果就不同，调用方无法依赖。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Shape (on `main`, unchanged by #34644)

- `/published` → 404, while the plain read → 200 with member fr-FR.
- `?member=en-US` → 404, while no member → 200.

`resolveBundleMemberSelector` treats each pair as the same request. Pin each pair to one answer, or make the selector tell them apart and document why.
